name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his father in Belgrade. He pursued mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, before landing an internship at a small racing outfit. His analytical mind and ability to quickly diagnose issues impressed his superiors, leading to a full-time role. Nikola honed his skills at various levels of motorsport before joining Crown Racing.

He is a meticulous and demanding engineer, known for his relentless pursuit of performance gains. Nikola believes in a data-driven approach, but also values the driver's feedback. His ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, coupled with his unwavering commitment to perfection, makes him a valuable asset to any team. He strives for excellence, always looking for innovative solutions to push the boundaries of performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on top.
physical.description: Nikola is of medium build with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace, even at the track.
